page.overview:
Who is Harald?

Harald was the most recent king of Elbaph and a member of the Knights of God. He is the father of Hajrudin and Loki, born respectively from Ida, his original lover, and Estrid, his official spouse.

Celebrated as Elbaph's greatest king, Harald spent most of his reign campaigning to undo his homeland's reputation as a warmongering nation and affiliate it with the World Government. Among his local accomplishments were the construction of the Walrus School and the several branch routes that connect Elbaph's villages together. However, 14 years ago Harald was betrayed by the World Government, which corrupted him in an attempt to enslave his subjects. Despite this, Harald foiled their plot by having his son Loki kill him, though the true reason for his death would not become known by the rest of Elbaph until the present day.

Harald's life and death make him a major figure in the events of the Elbaph Arc.

Harald was a broad-shouldered muscular giant who sported jagged eyebrows and a curved double-line tattoo framing his left temple and going through his left eye. Due to his lineage as a descendant of ancient giants, Harald was larger than most modern giants and was born with a pair of horns poking from his head.
